_meta.purpose: v1 starter list of topic-indexed communities for the Social Arbitrage Engine. Each community gets per-(concept, community, day) z-score baselines per D21 S3.
_meta.philosophy: broad-based, holistic — favor communities where most participants don't know or care that the brand is publicly traded (Camillo principle). Skew away from investing-flavored communities; favor hobby/passion/lifestyle/product verticals.

tier_definitions.niche: small, topic-focused community. Z-score thresholds tightest here. Highest signal/noise.
tier_definitions.mega: large, broad-topic. Z-score thresholds loosest. Lowest signal/noise but high coverage of behavior shifts.

status_definitions.seed: endpoint identifier is stable and known; collector can be wired without further operator input.
status_definitions.tbd: operator must fill in specific endpoint, server invite, or forum URL before collector can be wired.

auth_required_definitions.none: fully public, no auth, no rate-limit-driving headers
auth_required_definitions.bot_invite: operator must register a bot account and obtain per-server invite (Discord)
auth_required_definitions.scrape_only: no public API; HTML scrape required (respect robots.txt; rate-limit conservatively)

_meta.phase_1_7_future_add: Reddit communities (deferred per D29). When unlocked, add reddit_* entries here without code changes.
review_checklist_for_user: Are the 5 source types correct, or swap one?
Do the Bluesky hashtags cover the verticals you care about?
Are the Discord categories the right ones (or add/remove)?
Are any of the placeholder forum URLs wrong / better alternatives known?
Tier assignments — anything that should shift niche↔general↔mega?

communities.endpoint_hint: https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?tags=front_page
communities.notes: Catch-all stream; high volume, broad. Use as 'mega tier' for baseline comparison. Z-score threshold should be highest here.

communities.endpoint_hint: https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?tags=show_hn
communities.notes: Founders/devs showing new products — early-stage product launches and adoption signals. High Camillo-relevance for tech/dev tooling category leaders.

communities.endpoint_hint: https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?tags=ask_hn
communities.notes: Questions reveal pain points and tool-switching behavior; useful for 'people are abandoning X for Y' signals.

communities.endpoint_hint: https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query=AI+OR+LLM+OR+machine+learning
communities.notes: Keyword-filtered slice of HN. Signals about which AI providers/products are getting traction or losing it.

communities.endpoint_hint: https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query=hardware+OR+chip+OR+device
communities.notes: Captures discussions about specific hardware launches, chip vendors, device adoption.

communities.endpoint_hint: https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query=fintech+OR+payments+OR+banking
communities.notes: Behavior shifts in payments, banking, fintech adoption.

communities.endpoint_hint: https://a.4cdn.org/biz/catalog.json (then per-thread /biz/thread/{id}.json)
communities.notes: Crypto and micro-cap chatter. High noise but occasionally early on cryptos and small-caps. Authenticity-Layer hard-limits will need to be aggressive here (low account-history visibility).

communities.endpoint_hint: Filter /biz/ catalog for thread subjects matching $TICKER pattern
communities.notes: Slice of /biz/ filtered to threads explicitly tagged with tickers. These are ticker-indexed enough that StockTwits cross-check has high relevance.

communities.endpoint_hint: https://a.4cdn.org/g/catalog.json
communities.notes: Tech/hardware/software discussion. Useful for early consumer-tech adoption shifts (e.g., GPU brand preferences, OS migration patterns).

communities.endpoint_hint: Filter /g/ catalog for hardware/chip-vendor thread subjects
communities.notes: Slice of /g/ for hardware-vendor-specific threads. Useful for detecting consumer hardware brand momentum.

communities.endpoint_hint: AT Protocol firehose, filter posts tagged #ai
